about: Every generated sound of the game: the model, its pinned settings and the exact request. tools/gen_sounds.py makes audio/sfx/<group>/<id>_<n>.wav and audio/music/<id>.wav from it, each with a .json sidecar (request, fal request id, sha256). Procedural sounds are not here: they are code (Private/Audio/AmbienceDSP.cpp). Provenance of everything: audio/SOURCES.md.
